evidence: The models that were trained were: Support Vector Machine (SVM), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Long-Short Term Memory Recurrent Neural Network (LSTM-RNN)
four metrics were used in order to compare the validity of the dataset, specifically Accuracy, Precision, Recall, Fall-out
The parameters of this classifier were penalty parameter (C=1), 4-fold crossvalidation and a number of max iterations equal to 100000
we extracted 5% of the original dataset via the use of select MySQL queries
unresolved: No seed/trial count stated anywhere; SVM uses 4-fold cross-validation but RNN/LSTM training procedure gives no repetition or CV count, so n_seeds left null rather than imputed
No train/test split percentages given for RNN/LSTM (only 4-fold CV mentioned for SVM); exact evaluation protocol for the two NN models is not explicit

n_eval_types set to 4 per the paper's own explicit statement (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, Fall-out); ROC curves and training time are also reported but not named as 'metrics' by the authors, so were not added to the count

Table 1 compares Bot-IoT against nine other public datasets, but this is a qualitative literature comparison, not an experimental evaluation run by this paper, so n_datasets is kept at 1 (Bot-IoT only)
